description: Free product samples creators asked for (a campaign offers products with sampleProducts on create_/update_creator_campaign). No action: the requests with each creator's shipping address and whether a post is owed (none since approval within sampleContentDueDays); status pending is the queue. With sampleId + action: approve (method ship = you send it yourself; method code = a single-use code on your Shopify store for that one product, previewed without confirm:true), decline (reason, shown to the creator) or ship (trackingUrl, carrier, shown to the creator). The creator is told on their page and by email.
name: campaign_samples
title: Review creator product sample requests
